function.description: Get detailed compliance breakdown by type (PSIRT, EOX, CONFIG, IMAGE) with source-level violations for a device.
function.name: api_deviceComplianceStatus

complianceStatus.description: Current compliance status of the device that will be one of COMPLIANT, NON_COMPLIANT, ERROR, IN_PROGRESS, NOT_APPLICABLE, NOT_AVAILABLE, COMPLIANT_WARNING, REMEDIATION_IN_PROGRESS, or ABORTED.

lastUpdateTime.description: Timestamp when the latest compliance checks ran.

scheduleTime.description: Timestamp when the next compliance checks will run.
